text.text_excerpt: Why, hello, there, Pelican Bay, newest restaurant on Elysian Fields, purveyor of the absolute best frozen daiquiris in the city, not to mention fresh & delicious food prepared & served with much love. Check me out - FTR (First To Review) and first to set a 5-star precedence, I'm sure. Stupid me, I didn't bring an appetite, just a thirst for a piña colada because I knew here they have it in the machine so I wouldn't tempt the stink eye from a bartender (I was that bartender once, I admit). Here, you can order any kind of frozen concoction you want because they have a wall of frozen drink machines glorious churning up the colorful sweet stuff. Great food. Location is prime. Pricing is fair. People are wonderful, happy (they dance to the overhead music) and very friendly. I've seen this place transition several times over the years now & I'm quite pleased with what it is now. Since this place was already bookmarked by me, thanks to Joi's phenomenal review, yeaaaaaa, I knew it was going to be good... and it didn't disappoint. Entering maybe a little confusing as there are 2 doors, but one is CLEARLY marked stating the entry is to be gained by using the other day... so there goes that. Once inside, you're greeted by a friendly hostess, who seats you, provides a menu & advises you that your server will be with you shortly. Once the...

Man thank you Yelp for recommending Pelican Bay. After reading reviews on their daiquiris and fab food, I had to check this place out! Food and daiquiris were both amazing! I got the Pina colada daiquiri and their catfish with a side of jambalaya and side salad. Sooooo good! Also got the bread pudding. Yumz! Also throw out to my waitress Shanelle. She was awesome! Actually everyone who works here is pretty awesome. Felt like I was eating at my family's. Can't get that customer service hospitality no where else but here.
